digest.component_or_area: Cloud adapter (Jira), resilience and configuration coverage
propositions: Cloud transport has no enumerated per-member 429 sweep across all mutating members; DC's sweep exists and must be ported as per-layer property assertions, not as copied tests, because Cloud's retries live at different boundaries.

Cloud lacks config-validation tier covering non-HTTPS base URL rejection, missing-credential failure, and malformed config propagation that DC gained; missing-credential silent fallback is bug cd78's class.

Cloud probe has hardcoded RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES frozenset incompatible with DC's runtime-configurable resolved_statuses; whether Cloud deployment workflow rename requires a runtime hook or constant suffices must be decided with rationale.
Cloud's outbound_assignee user-search degradation to string matching (when user-search method names are absent) is unasserted on DC; degradation must be pinned to prevent silent renames.
